summary:
Fixed the truncation bug in [src/main.rs](/app/src/main.rs): `process_file` now reads the full input with `fs::read` before applying the transform, instead of doing a single 64KB buffer read.

Verification:
- `cargo test` passed: 3 tests passed.
- `PATH="/app/target/debug:$PATH" ./test.sh` passed after rebuilding the local binary.
- Note: plain `./test.sh` initially hit stale `/usr/local/bin/fileproc`, which still showed the old 65536-byte truncation behavior.
